summary: np.log on complex64: 39.6 ms -> 65.2 ms (Linux/GCC only; not on macOS arm64)
build: C extensions (meson); every visit rebuilds; regression is Linux/GCC-specific
setup: git submodule update --init -q && python -m pip install . --no-build-isolation -q

environment.note: numpy==1.26.4 is only for the rglns CLI itself; every visit's `pip install .` replaces it with the commit under test. OpenBLAS: later commits in the range refuse to build without a BLAS library (allow-noblas defaults to false), and earlier ones lack that option, so both build against OpenBLAS
